question: List Breast Chemotherapy trials where overall follow‑up exceeded 21 months.

gemini.answer: This query lists clinical trials related to breast cancer with treatment regimens involving chemotherapy and an overall follow-up duration exceeding 21 months, displaying the NCT ID, author, year, and PubMed ID.
gemini.raw:
```json
{
  "sql": "SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\" FROM public.\"clinical_trials\" WHERE \"cancer_type\" ILIKE '%Breast%' AND \"treatment_regimen\" ILIKE '%Chemotherapy%' AND \"follow_up_duration_overall_months\" > 21",
  "answer": "This query lists clinical trials related to breast cancer with treatment regimens involving chemotherapy and an overall follow-up duration exceeding 21 months, displaying the NCT ID, author, year, and PubMed ID.",
  "assumptions": ""
}
```
